$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.haxe.imports. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-PUOSI-OTHER-USE
arms.note: a bare name read other than as a call no longer keeps the import, so `prefer-using-over-static-import` deletes an import a remaining read still needs

arms.name: M-PUOSI-VERDICT
arms.note: a call whose receiver the gates did not prove is rewritten all the same, so the import goes with calls the extension form may bind elsewhere

arms.name: M-PUOSI-LOCAL-NAME
arms.note: a local or parameter of the imported name counts as a use of the import, so the import stays beside calls that are all rewritable

arms.name: M-PUOSI-BINDING-DECLINE
arms.note: a bare call is taken to mean the import wherever it stands, so a member of the enclosing type that outranks the import is rewritten past

arms.name: M-PUOSI-INTERP-READ
arms.note: a `$name` read inside a string is no use of the bare name, so the import is deleted beside a read only the interpolation spells and the build has to revert it
